name: In-Line Dimmer Module (Dual-Band)

steps.text: At the electrical panel, turn off the circuit breakers or remove the fuses feeding the wall box, and make sure the power is off.
Remove the fixture's wall plate, unscrew the fixture and pull it out from the junction box.
Disconnect the wires from the fixture and make sure there is 1/2 inch of bare wire on the ends.
Making sure the wires are not touching, turn the breakers back on.
Use a voltage meter to identify the line and load wires connected to the fixture, then identify the neutral and ground wires.
Turn off the breakers.
Connect the dimmer's bare copper wire to ground, white to neutral, red to load and black to line (100 to 277V). Make sure the connections are firm with no exposed wire.
Before reinstalling the fixture, turn on the circuit breaker supplying power to it.
Use the dimmer's ON and OFF buttons to test load control.
steps.expect: The load turns on and off.

steps.text: Add the dimmer to scenes as a responder of the Insteon devices you want.
Turn off the breakers.
Gently place the dimmer into the junction box, making sure nothing can accidentally press the buttons on its face.
Reinstall the fixture.
Turn on the breakers.

notes: Controls incandescent loads up to 400W at 100 to 277VAC, 50/60Hz.

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button to start linking mode.

notes: As a responder: set the load with the ON and OFF buttons to the state the scene should recall, press and hold the controller's scene button until it beeps, then press and hold the dimmer's SET button until it double-beeps. The status LED flashes, then turns green if the load is on or red if off.
Linking mode times out after 4 minutes of inactivity. To leave it, tap any button except the SET button.
A double-beep means a successful link or unlink; continuous beeps for 3 seconds mean an unsuccessful link or the 4-minute setup timeout.

verification.note: The In-Line Dimmer Module (Dual-Band) 2475DA1 Owner's Manual describes linking only as a responder; that holding the SET button starts linking mode comes from its button table and LED table.

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button until the dimmer beeps.
Press and hold the SET button again until the dimmer beeps.

notes: To remove the dimmer as a responder: press and hold the controller's scene button until it beeps, press and hold it again until it beeps, then press and hold the dimmer's SET button until it double-beeps.

verification.note: The In-Line Dimmer Module (Dual-Band) 2475DA1 Owner's Manual gives these presses as the first steps of a factory reset; its LED table says blinking red is unlinking mode.

steps.text: If possible, remove all scene memberships first.
Press and hold the SET button until the dimmer beeps.
Press and hold the SET button again until the dimmer beeps.
Double-tap the SET button, then press and hold it until the long beep stops.
steps.expect: long beep; LED turns off and the load turns on

notes: With a partner: turn off the circuit breaker, press and hold the SET button while the partner turns the breaker back on, and keep holding until the long beep stops, then release. The dimmer double-beeps, its LED turns green and the load turns on.
Continuous beeps for 10 seconds warn that a factory reset is coming.

steps.text: Remove the dimmer from all of its scene controllers.
Uninstall the dimmer.

notes: Otherwise controllers experience delays and may show flashing error indications.
Returns its load and LEDs to their states before a power outage.
Its owner's manual describes linking it only as a responder.
sources: In-Line Dimmer Module (Dual-Band) 2475DA1 Quick Start Guide
